reviews.text: These guys are phenomenal. Don’t shop around, don’t go looking for a copy cat. Go with Adam and Jamie at next century screens. We had Phantom screens installed and couldn’t be happier. They will service and replace any faultiness you may experience- although for the most part our screens held up for years with no issues. We had a minor rip in one of the screens after 2 years of Texas wind and hail, and finally after a bit of breakdown the whole screen ripped. They replaced it all. They come out and take care of any issues you may have with no questions asked. We need more companies like these guys in the contractor space. Too many guys that take your money and run, but these guys always make it right. I have referred friends to them and I will keep on doing so. Thank you guys.
reviews.author: Hadi Bayatneh

reviews.text:
The retractable screens operate with ease and somewhat disappear when not in use. We enjoy letting some fresh air into our home without mosquitoes entering. They’re perfect for Fall weather.
Christian did a fantastic job of installing them. He was very meticulous and didn’t leave until he was completely satisfied with the installation.  He seems to be proud of the product and company he represents as he spoke highly of Next Century Screens and its  management.  Great product and excellent service.
reviews.author: Laura Jones

reviews.text: We had motorized screens installed in 2022 and we love them.  We enjoy sitting outdoors without being bothered by mosquitos and other insects. They block the sun and afford us privacy. Everyone is very professional, courteous, and efficient. We highly recommend to everyone!
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: We looked at several different vendors for our automatic screens on our back porch when building our new home. Next Century came highly recommended so we went with them and I’m very glad we did. They are the highest quality screens I’ve seen and they did an outstanding job installing them. Also, their customer service has been top notch. I can’t say enough nice things about this company!
reviews.author: Clark Costa

reviews.text: Christian & Adam , did a great job.  Here’s a company that invest into their employee’s who become passionate about their craft and the result’s were a great screen door for my 8 Ft patio door.
reviews.author: Marc kahn

reviews.text: We love this retractable screen door that Next Century Screens installed close to 1 year ago. We love being able to keep our living room door open and enjoy the weather, while keeping out the bugs. The screen door glides so smoothly on the tracks and is so sturdy that you won't regret getting one.
reviews.author: Brenda G

reviews.text: Very pleased with my experience with Next Century Screens.  The previous owners of our home installed motorized screens on the covered back patio……..what a great upgrade.  They keep the mosquitos and leaves etc out so we can enjoy the space almost daily.  I needed a small repair and some adjustment and they scheduled it quickly, arrived when they promised and were very friendly.  Great experience…..highly recommend.
reviews.author: The Nolans

reviews.text: Another 5 stars from us. Noah was friendly, professional, did a great job, and as always, we are most pleased with your work. Love your screens and excellent service.
reviews.author: Pat Krapf
